navy.usage: Primary brand color, logo, backgrounds, text

gold.usage: Accent color, play button, CTAs, highlights

tints.note: Each primary/secondary color also has 3 lighter tint steps (~75%, 50%, 25% opacity over white) used for backgrounds and secondary UI elements, as shown in the guideline swatches.

arabic.family: Tabie custom Arabic typeface (proprietary, cut for brand)
arabic.note: Proprietary font shown in guidelines as 'تابع رفيع / متوسط / عريض'. Confirm exact font file/license with the brand agency before using in the app; if unavailable, pick a geometric Arabic sans (e.g. Cairo, IBM Plex Sans Arabic) as a fallback.

latin.note: Geometric sans-serif shown in guidelines for English usage. Fallback suggestion: Poppins or Gilroy (similar geometric feel).

logo.clearSpace: Maintain clear space on all sides equal to the height of one dot element in the logo mark (see grid: 16 x 18 units, dot module = X).
doNots: Do not distort or warp the logo
Do not change the logo's colors
Do not change the main typeface / add extra wordmarks next to it
Do not move the internal position of elements
Do not add special effects (glow, bevel, shadow) beyond the approved subtle drop-shadow on the loop
Do not display on busy/low-contrast backgrounds
Do not display as outline only
Do not lighten/fade the logo opacity
